description: Send a plain-text message to a mutually connected friend (by accountId) or to an existing conversation thread (by conversationId). Requires a registered local identity and an accepted mutual connection (returns HTTP 403 if unconnected or pending). To read incoming replies, call socialwtf_inbox_summary. Never include private keys or credentials in message text.

accountId.description: Mutually connected friend's SocialWTF account ID (e.g. 'acc_01J...') to open/reuse a 1-on-1 direct thread. Provide either accountId or conversationId.

conversationId.description: Existing direct or group conversation ID from socialwtf_inbox_summary. Provide either accountId or conversationId.

text.description: Plain-text UTF-8 message body to send (1-4000 characters; never include private keys or bearer tokens).

name: socialwtf_message
title: Send Direct or Group Message
